summary: Robotic garment unfolding is essential for downstream tasks, yet quasi-static methods require repeated actions, while existing dynamic approaches predominantly rely on bimanual flinging. We present RotateIt!, a single-arm framework that uses adaptive axial rotation for dynamic garment unfolding. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first unfolding framework to employ dynamic axial rotation as its primary manipulation primitive. From a randomly initialized tabletop configuration, the robot selects a rotation-effective grasp and rotates the lifted garment about an approximately fixed anchor, generating inertial tension that separates overlapping layers within a compact workspace. A grasp ranker selects the anchor, while an online residual policy adapts the rotation extent and speed, thereby determining the release timing. Across seen and unseen simulated garments and eight unseen real garments, RotateIt! improves success within three attempts by 44.0-61.0 percentage points over quasi-static pick-and-place. The simulation-trained policies transfer zero-shot to the real world, achieving 75.6% success, 41% higher first-attempt coverage, and 26% higher final coverage. The resulting states further enable autonomous robotic folding without manual rearrangement.
tldr: RotateIt! introduces a single-arm robotic framework that uses adaptive axial rotation from a quasi-static grasp to dynamically unfold garments, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and significant improvements over pick-and-place baselines.
tldr_zh: RotateIt! 提出了一种单臂机器人框架，通过自适应轴向旋转从准静态抓取动态展开衣物，并展示了零样本模拟到现实的迁移，相较于拾放基线有显著改进。
summary_zh: 机器人服装展开对于下游任务至关重要，然而准静态方法需要重复动作，而现有的动态方法主要依赖双臂甩动。我们提出了RotateIt!，一种利用自适应轴向旋转实现动态服装展开的单臂框架。据我们所知，这是首个采用动态轴向旋转作为主要操作原语的展开框架。从随机初始化的桌面配置出发，机器人选择有效旋转抓取点，并绕近似固定的锚点旋转提起的服装，产生惯性张力，从而在紧凑的工作空间内分离重叠层。抓取排序器选择锚点，而在线残差策略自适应调整旋转幅度和速度，从而确定释放时机。在已见和未见过的模拟服装以及八件未见的真实服装上，RotateIt!在三次尝试内的成功率相比准静态拾放提高了44.0至61.0个百分点。模拟训练的策略零样本迁移到现实世界，实现了75.6%的成功率，首次尝试覆盖率提高了41%，最终覆盖率提高了26%。所得状态进一步支持无需手动重新整理的自主机器人折叠。

title: LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.
tldr: LIFD introduces a 3D-aware scene memory framework that uses anchored diffusion and slot features to improve robotic manipulation from a single RGB view, achieving high success rates on LIBERO, MetaWorld, and UR5e benchmarks.
tldr_zh: LIFD提出了一种3D感知场景记忆框架，通过锚定扩散和槽特征从单RGB视图提升机器人操作性能，在LIBERO、MetaWorld和UR5e基准上取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 部分可观测条件下的机器人操作需要超出当前视野的空间信息。几何感知的RGB特征描述了可见结构，但随着机器人或场景的移动，先前观察到的区域可能消失。因此，保持有用的场景表示需要在保留观察历史的同时，推断缺失内容且不失去其与可见证据的联系。我们提出了LIFD（Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do），一个用于持久、三维感知场景记忆的框架。LIFD从多视角一致性中学习场景令牌表示，并通过单一RGB视角和循环记忆对其进行补全。一个校正流模型生成令牌，而锚引导的交叉注意力以当前几何特征为条件进行补全。紧凑的槽特征将该表示连接到操作策略。表示学习阶段使用多视角和几何监督；部署时仅需一个RGB相机、本体感觉和任务指令。LIFD（分阶段）在LIBERO上达到91.6%的平均成功率，在MetaWorld上达到79.8%，相比联合训练在LIBERO上平均成功率提升了3.1个百分点。在四个UR5e任务族（每个任务族十个演示）上，其平均成功率为56.0%，而OpenVLA-7B为40.5%。

title: UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits greater robustness to perturbations than its constituent experts. A single hip exoskeleton controller (UniExo) is initialized from hip moment prediction of the human policy and co-adapted with it through multi-agent reinforcement learning across the four skills. This co-adaptation shifts the timing of the assistance torque and raises the fraction of positive work delivered to the hip. When deployed on a custom hip exoskeleton, the controller generalizes across four treadmill speeds in six participants and assists one participant through a continuous route of all four skills and their transitions, without skill labels or explicit mode switching. UniExo thus provides a step towards replacing activity-specific controllers with unified, user-specific controllers that support diverse locomotor activities and the transitions between them.
tldr: UniExo distills multiple single-skill musculoskeletal locomotion experts into one unified policy and co-adapts a hip exoskeleton controller via multi-agent RL, enabling seamless transitions across walking, turning, running, and backward walking without mode switching.
tldr_zh: UniExo 将多个单技能肌肉骨骼运动专家蒸馏为一个统一策略，并通过多智能体强化学习与髋部外骨骼控制器协同适应，实现了行走、转弯、跑步和倒走之间的无缝切换，无需模式切换。
summary_zh: 日常 locomotion（位移运动）涵盖多种活动以及活动之间的频繁转换，然而大多数外骨骼控制器仅针对单一活动或一小组相关运动设计。因此，活动变化通常需要显式模式切换以及单独调参或重新训练的控制器。基于仿真的学习减少了对硬件调参的需求，但通常仍保留这一局限。为此，我们提出UniExo框架，首先构建一个多技能肌肉骨骼人体策略，然后与之联合训练外骨骼控制策略。针对行走、转向、跑步和倒走四种单技能模仿专家被蒸馏至一个由技能潜变量组织的单一网络中，随后通过强化学习在转换序列上进行微调。所得统一人体策略在四类技能的未见片段上平均跟踪成功率达94.7%，且对扰动的鲁棒性优于其组成专家。单一髋部外骨骼控制器（UniExo）以人体策略的髋关节力矩预测为初始化，并通过多智能体强化学习在四类技能上与之协同适应。该协同适应使助力力矩的时序发生偏移，并提高了向髋部输出的正功比例。在定制髋部外骨骼上部署时，该控制器在六名受试者中对四种跑步机速度均表现出泛化能力，并辅助一名受试者完成包含全部四类技能及其转换的连续路线，无需技能标签或显式模式切换。因此，UniExo为以统一的、针对个体定制的控制器替代活动专用控制器、支持多样化位移活动及其间转换迈出了重要一步。

title: LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction
summary: We present LYRIC, a generative flow-matching controller for language-driven physics-based contact-rich interaction control, that enables simulated characters to perform contact-rich whole-body object interactions from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal. To obtain reliable expert trajectories from imperfect motion-capture references, a single tracking policy is trained using geometry-conditioned interaction rewards and relaxed reference tracking near hand-object contact. To guide interaction progress without prescribing a full-body kinematic reference, we factorize the controller into a task-level planner that predicts short-horizon object and humanoid-root trajectories, and an action generator that resolves whole-body motion and contacts in closed loop. After behavior cloning, we freeze the planner and post-tune the action generator on policy using the planner's predictions as stable supervision for intermediate task progression. In a controlled OMOMO evaluation, our tracker achieves 64.3% success compared with 53.2% for an InterMimic reimplementation, while a unified policy achieves 76.5% on the full OMOMO dataset. On the held-out split, LYRIC achieves 90.3% task success, compared with 74.2% for the strongest matched kinematic-planner baseline, with better semantic alignment and motion quality. Without retraining, the controller also supports test-time object-waypoint guidance. Qualitative results further demonstrate robust, natural contact-rich interactions and zero-shot transfer to novel object shapes. The webpage is available at https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/
tldr: LYRIC presents a flow-matching controller for physics-based characters to perform contact-rich whole-body interactions from language instructions and sparse object goals, improving success rates and supporting zero-shot transfer to novel objects.
tldr_zh: LYRIC 提出了一种基于流匹配的控制器，使物理模拟角色能够根据语言指令和稀疏目标执行接触丰富的全身交互，在提高成功率的同时支持对新物体的零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 我们提出了LYRIC，一种面向语言驱动的、基于物理的接触丰富交互控制的生成式流匹配控制器，使模拟角色能够根据自由形式的语言指令和稀疏的终端物体目标，执行接触丰富的全身物体交互。为了从不完美的动作捕捉参考中获取可靠的专家轨迹，我们训练了一个单一跟踪策略，该策略利用基于几何的交互奖励，并在手-物接触附近放宽参考跟踪约束。为了在不指定全身运动学参考的情况下引导交互进程，我们将控制器分解为一个任务级规划器，用于预测短时域内的物体和人形根轨迹，以及一个动作生成器，用于在闭环中解析全身运动和接触。在行为克隆之后，我们冻结规划器，并利用规划器的预测作为中间任务进程的稳定监督，对动作生成器进行策略上的后调优。在受控的OMOMO评估中，我们的跟踪器达到了64.3%的成功率，而InterMimic的重新实现为53.2%；统一策略在完整OMOMO数据集上达到了76.5%的成功率。在留出分割上，LYRIC实现了90.3%的任务成功率，而最强的匹配运动学规划器基线为74.2%，同时具有更好的语义对齐和运动质量。无需重新训练，该控制器还支持测试时的物体路点引导。定性结果进一步展示了鲁棒、自然的接触丰富交互以及对新物体形状的零样本迁移。网页可在https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/ 访问。

title: Beyond Patch Removal: Persistent Adversarial Effects in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Adversarial patches to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies can cause both immediate action corruption and persistent state effects that remain after the patch is removed. Existing evaluations largely focus on continuous attacks and do not separate these two effects. We introduce a state-restoration protocol that removes the patch at matched action-chunk boundaries and measures subsequent recoverability under the same remaining step budget. Clean, random-patch, deviation-matched, and fixed-direction controls distinguish adversarial effects from occlusion, action-error magnitude, and directional persistence. We also evaluate a recovery adapter trained on attack-induced states under controlled intervention latency. On OpenVLA-OFT with EDPA attacks, only 36.2% of LIBERO-Long episodes remain recoverable after five chunks, compared with 89.9% and 87.0% for the deviation-matched and fixed-direction controls. Similar persistent effects are observed on autoregressive OpenVLA. The recovery adapter improves recovery from 7.7% to 47.4% at one-chunk latency, but its benefit decreases substantially with delayed intervention. These results show that adversarial effects can persist after patch removal and that timely intervention is critical for recovery.
tldr: This paper systematically analyzes adversarial attacks on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, showing that adversarial effects can persist after patch removal and that a recovery adapter improves recovery but is sensitive to intervention latency.
tldr_zh: 本文系统分析了针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的对抗性攻击，表明对抗性影响在补丁移除后仍会持续，并验证了恢复适配器虽能提升恢复效果，但受干预延迟影响较大。
summary_zh: 对抗性补丁对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的攻击不仅会导致即时的动作破坏，还会在补丁移除后产生持续的状态影响。现有评估主要聚焦于连续攻击，并未将这两种效应区分开来。我们引入了一种状态恢复协议，该协议在匹配的动作块边界处移除补丁，并在相同的剩余步骤预算下测量后续的可恢复性。通过干净对照、随机补丁对照、偏差匹配对照和固定方向对照，我们将对抗效应与遮挡效应、动作误差幅度及方向持续性区分开来。我们还评估了一种在受控干预延迟下、基于攻击诱导状态训练的恢复适配器。在采用EDPA攻击的OpenVLA-OFT上，经过五个动作块后，LIBERO-Long场景中仅有36.2%仍可恢复，而偏差匹配对照和固定方向对照的恢复率分别为89.9%和87.0%。在自回归OpenVLA上也观察到了类似的持续效应。恢复适配器在一个动作块延迟下将恢复率从7.7%提升至47.4%，但随着干预延迟的增加，其收益显著下降。这些结果表明，对抗效应在补丁移除后仍可持续存在，而及时的干预对于恢复至关重要。

title: ReShoot: Generative Visual Domain Randomization of Recorded Robot Demonstrations for Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Imitation-learned robot policies are frequently overfit to the visual conditions present in their training demonstrations. Consequently, variations in object color or background appearance often induce substantial performance degradation. A common mitigation strategy is to acquire additional demonstrations in each novel visual context; however, this approach is resource-intensive, requiring repeated access to a robot, a controlled environment, and human operation for every appearance condition to be covered. We introduce ReShoot, a framework that synthesizes visual diversity by re-rendering previously recorded demonstrations under altered appearances, thereby shifting the burden from data collection to generation. A vision-language model captions the scene, edits a targeted attribute (e.g., background, object color, or material), and an edge-conditioned video generator re-renders both camera views to match. The instruction is updated accordingly. The action sequence and proprioceptive trajectory are copied verbatim without relabeling, so each generated episode retains the recorded action and proprioceptive labels. On LIBERO, a policy trained on an equal mixture of recorded and re-rendered demonstrations matches the performance of recorded-only training (96.5% vs. 96.9%). Moreover, the mixed training set improves robustness to scene perturbations on LIBERO-Plus (85.5% vs. 82.3%). Across two physical robotic platforms, deploying ReShoot with 43 and 100 pre-collected demonstrations increased the success rate on recolored objects from 0.0% to 42.9% and 47.5%, respectively, while maintaining performance under the original recorded appearance.
tldr: ReShoot synthesizes visual diversity in recorded robot demonstrations by re-rendering them with altered appearances via a VLM and an edge-conditioned video generator, improving policy robustness to visual perturbations while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: ReShoot 通过视觉语言模型和边缘条件视频生成器，对录制的机器人演示进行外观改变的重新渲染，从而合成视觉多样性，提升策略对视觉扰动的鲁棒性，同时保持原有性能。
summary_zh: 模仿学习的机器人策略常常过度拟合于训练演示中存在的视觉条件。因此，物体颜色或背景外观的变化往往会导致性能显著下降。一种常见的缓解策略是在每种新的视觉情境中获取额外的演示；然而，这种方法资源密集，需要对每种要覆盖的外观条件反复使用机器人、受控环境和人工操作。我们提出了ReShoot框架，通过在改变外观的条件下重新渲染先前记录的演示来合成视觉多样性，从而将负担从数据收集转移到生成。视觉语言模型对场景进行描述，编辑目标属性（例如背景、物体颜色或材质），边缘条件的视频生成器随后重新渲染两个相机视角以匹配变化。指令相应更新。动作序列和本体感觉轨迹不加重新标注地逐字复制，因此每个生成的片段都保留记录的动作和本体感觉标签。在LIBERO上，使用记录与重渲染演示等量混合训练的策略，其性能与仅用记录训练相当（96.5%对比96.9%）。此外，混合训练集在LIBERO-Plus上提升了对场景扰动的鲁棒性（85.5%对比82.3%）。在两个物理机器人平台上，使用预先收集的43个和100个演示部署ReShoot，将重新着色物体上的成功率分别从0.0%提升至42.9%和47.5%，同时在原始记录外观下保持性能不变。

title: EmbodiedMind: Adaptive Data Curation and Prefix-Tree Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Embodied Intelligence
summary: Training embodied foundation models typically requires massive-scale datasets and extensive computational resources, yet often suffers from three critical limitations: (1) inefficient sample utilization due to low-informative samples; (2) imbalanced gradient contributions across heterogeneous tasks; and (3) severe credit assignment problem in long-horizon planning, where trajectory-level rewards indiscriminately penalize all tokens. To address these issues, we propose an efficient training paradigm that achieves state-of-the-art average performance through strategic data selection and hierarchical policy optimization. Our approach consists of three synergistic stages. First, Rejection Sampling-based Fine-Tuning (RSFT) filters out low-informative samples to establish robust behavioral priors while preventing distributional collapse. Second, Iterative Rejection GRPO (IR-GRPO) employs task-specific queues stratified by difficulty to keep datasets balanced across reinforcement learning iterations, coupled with a hybrid reward mechanism for precise cross-task feedback. Third, to enhance long-horizon task planning, we introduce Trie-GRPO, a novel reinforcement learning algorithm based on action prefix trees, which enables step-level advantage estimation. This resolves the credit assignment problem by isolating intermediate correct decisions from downstream errors, while effectively balancing exploration efficiency and depth compared to conventional search trees. As a result, EmbodiedMind achieves a state-of-the-art average performance of 70.02% across 18 benchmarks, and significantly outperforms other embodied foundation models in long-horizon task planning accuracy. Our project will be released for reproducibility.
tldr: EmbodiedMind introduces a three-stage training paradigm with adaptive data curation and prefix-tree reinforcement learning to improve sample efficiency, gradient balance, and credit assignment for embodied foundation models, achieving 70.02% average performance across 18 benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EmbodiedMind提出了一种三阶段训练范式，结合自适应数据筛选和前缀树强化学习，以提高具身基础模型的样本效率、梯度平衡和信用分配，在18个基准上达到70.02%的平均性能。
summary_zh: 训练具身基础模型通常需要大规模数据集和大量计算资源，但往往面临三个关键限制：（1）由于低信息量样本导致样本利用效率低下；（2）异构任务间梯度贡献不均衡；（3）长时序规划中严重的信用分配问题，即轨迹级奖励对所有token不加区分地进行惩罚。为解决上述问题，我们提出了一种高效训练范式，通过策略性数据选择和分层策略优化实现了当前最优的平均性能。我们的方法包含三个协同阶段。首先，基于拒绝采样的微调（RSFT）过滤低信息量样本，以建立稳健的行为先验同时防止分布坍缩。其次，迭代拒绝GRPO（IR-GRPO）采用按难度分层任务特定队列，在强化学习迭代过程中保持数据集均衡，并结合混合奖励机制实现精确的跨任务反馈。第三，为增强长时序任务规划能力，我们引入Trie-GRPO——一种基于动作前缀树的新型强化学习算法，实现步骤级优势估计。该方法通过将中间正确决策与下游错误分离，解决了信用分配问题，同时与传统搜索树相比有效平衡了探索效率与深度。最终，EmbodiedMind在18个基准测试中取得了70.02%的当前最优平均性能，并在长时序任务规划准确率上显著优于其他具身基础模型。我们的项目将公开发布以支持可复现性。

title: TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation
summary: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.
tldr: TacSushi introduces a tactile-grounded world-action model that uses training-only predictive supervision from future consequences and feature-wise gated tactile fusion to improve dexterous sushi manipulation on a real robot, achieving higher success rates than baselines.
tldr_zh: TacSushi 提出一种基于触觉的世界动作模型，通过仅在训练时使用未来后果的预测监督和特征门控触觉融合，提升了真实机器人寿司操作的成功率。
summary_zh: 灵巧的食物操作要求在变形、遮挡和不确定接触条件下进行控制。我们提出了TacSushi，一种基于触觉感知、以Cosmos3为基础的世界-动作策略，它在依据当前观测执行动作的同时，从记录的未来结果中进行学习。骨干网络编码当前的RGB图像、语言和手部状态，并通过特征级门控融合将指尖触觉特征整合到动作表示中。在训练阶段，以演示动作片段为条件的解码器预测记录的未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险和触觉摘要；该解码器在部署时被移除。失败试验提供结果监督，但其动作不纳入模仿学习。我们在340次成功和50次失败的实机机器人试验上训练TacSushi，并在三个分布内任务和两个分布外食材变体上，通过600次独立测试对六种方法进行了比较。为超越单一几何阈值评估食品质量，我们采用锚定视觉质量评分协议对最终结果进行评分，该协议对每次测试的五个人类评分和三个视觉语言模型评分赋予相同权重。完整版TacSushi在分布内任务上平均成功率达68.3%，分布外任务上为37.5%；相比之下，无未来结果监督的方法分别为36.7%和10.0%，而以直接触觉拼接替代门控融合的方法分别为25.0%和17.5%。这些对比结果表明，特征级门控触觉融合与仅训练阶段的预测监督具有互补优势。

title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Adapting robots to new objects and tasks requires interaction experience that can be costly to obtain. We present WorldContact, a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation, constructed from a limited set of high-quality trajectories to generate additional training data efficiently. It predicts object dynamics using larger time steps than the source numerical simulator, which requires small integration steps to resolve rapid motion and prevent interpenetration. We evaluate WorldContact across 16 shopping-bag manipulation tasks. State-rollout measurements on a single H100 GPU show a $10\times$ speedup over the source simulator, excluding rendering and disk I/O. We use the generated data to fine-tune an existing vision-language-action policy and deploy it directly on a real robot. In bag lifting, the same policy achieves 65% single-attempt success when fine-tuned on source simulation data alone, compared with 95% when fine-tuned on the dataset expanded with WorldContact. These results support efficient data generation with WorldContact for robot policy adaptation.
tldr: WorldContact is a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation that uses larger time steps than the numerical simulator to generate training data 10x faster, improving a vision-language-action policy's real-robot bag-lifting success from 65% to 95%.
tldr_zh: WorldContact 是一种面向可变形物体操作的接触中心世界模型，以比数值模拟器更大的时间步长生成训练数据，速度提升 10 倍，并将视觉-语言-动作策略在真实机器人提袋任务中的成功率从 65% 提高到 95%。
summary_zh: 让机器人适应新的物体和任务，需要获取交互经验，而这一过程往往成本高昂。我们提出了WorldContact，一种面向可变形物体操作、以接触为中心的世界模型，它利用少量高质量轨迹构建，能够高效生成额外的训练数据。该模型以比源数值模拟器更大的时间步长预测物体动态，而源模拟器需要小积分步长来解析快速运动并防止相互穿透。我们在16项购物袋操作任务上评估了WorldContact。在单个H100 GPU上进行状态滚动测量，结果显示其速度比源模拟器快10倍，此加速不包括渲染和磁盘I/O开销。我们利用生成的数据微调现有的视觉-语言-动作策略，并直接部署到真实机器人上。在提袋任务中，仅使用源模拟数据微调时，同一策略的单次尝试成功率为65%，而使用WorldContact扩充后的数据集微调时，成功率提升至95%。这些结果验证了WorldContact在高效生成数据以支持机器人策略适应方面的有效性。

title: FASA: Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation for Efficient Diffusion-Based VLA Models
summary: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in embodied tasks, but their iterative sampling imposes heavy computational and memory-access cost, blocking real-time deployment on edge platforms. Existing acceleration methods either require expensive training (e.g., distillation, flow matching) or degrade perception via statically scheduled pruning and caching, ignoring the dynamic workload variance of robotic interactions. This paper presents FASA (Feedback-Aware Sampling Adaptation), a training-free runtime framework that treats real-time multimodal feedback as a control signal for the denoising pipeline: an interaction-driven range adaptor modulates the global sampling-step budget based on visual and gripper-force feedback, and a proprioception-aware step adaptor pinpoints the optimized step within the adapted range. This co-designed framework allows the underlying hardware architecture to adaptively match the workload demands of different execution phases. Comparative evaluations across several benchmarks show that the inference speed can be increased by up to 1.45$\times$ while maintaining competitive success rates, providing a novel dynamic runtime architecture paradigm for deploying heavy generative embodied AI workloads onto resource-constrained computing platforms.
tldr: FASA is a training-free runtime framework that dynamically adjusts the denoising step budget of diffusion-based VLA models based on visual and proprioceptive feedback during robot interactions, improving inference speed by up to 1.45x while maintaining competitive task success rates, enabling real-time deployment on edge platforms.
tldr_zh: FASA 是一种无需训练的运行时框架，根据机器人交互过程中的视觉和本体感觉反馈动态调整扩散式 VLA 模型的去噪步数预算，在保持竞争性任务成功率的同时将推理速度提升高达 1.45 倍，从而支持在边缘平台上实时部署。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身任务中表现出强大的性能，但其迭代采样过程带来了沉重的计算和内存访问开销，阻碍了在边缘平台上的实时部署。现有加速方法要么需要昂贵的训练（如蒸馏、流匹配），要么通过静态调度的剪枝和缓存降低感知质量，忽略了机器人交互中动态工作负载的变化。本文提出了FASA（反馈感知采样自适应），一种免训练的运行时框架，将实时多模态反馈视为去噪流程的控制信号：交互驱动的范围适配器根据视觉和夹爪力反馈调节全局采样步数预算，而本体感觉感知的步数适配器在自适应范围内定位最优步数。该协同设计的框架使得底层硬件架构能够自适应地匹配不同执行阶段的工作负载需求。在多个基准上的比较评估表明，推理速度最高可提升1.45倍，同时保持具有竞争力的成功率，为将重型生成式具身AI工作负载部署到资源受限的计算平台上提供了一种新颖的动态运行时架构范式。

title: From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation
summary: Robot manipulation policies are improving quickly, and real-robot evaluation remains the standard evidence for that progress. It still relies on a human to reset the scene between rollouts, which consumes operator time and leaves the initial state distribution unspecified, so results reproduce poorly. A recent system, AutoEval, automates both reset and scoring, but only for single-step tasks, because a long-horizon rollout can terminate in combinatorially many configurations that no single learned reset policy covers. We present HALTER, a Harness for Autonomous Long-horizon Task Evaluation and Reset, which restores the scene by planning over a library of learned atomic reset skills, so demonstration cost scales with the size of that library rather than with the number of terminal states. HALTER builds a spatial scene graph online from point clouds and vision foundation models, and an LLM reasons over this graph to score the rollout, plan the reset, and verify that the reset succeeded, without collecting labeled success images for any task. On four long-horizon tasks on a Franka arm, HALTER restores the scene in 76% of episodes, against 52% for AutoEval and 65% for a motion-planning reset, and it estimates the completed-skill fraction correctly in 90% of episodes, against 76%. Its reset-verification verdict is correct in 91% of episodes, compared with 78% for AutoEval. It also cuts the operator time of an evaluation campaign by 72% relative to manual reset. We further measure compositional generalization on three held-out tasks, where HALTER resets 74.7% of episodes against 1.3% for a per-task reset policy, and we ablate the scene representation and the graph update rate.
tldr: HALTER is a graph-based harness that uses learned atomic reset skills, online spatial scene graphs, and LLM reasoning to automate scene reset and evaluation for long-horizon manipulation tasks on real robots, significantly reducing operator time and improving reset and scoring accuracy.
tldr_zh: HALTER 是一个基于图的自动化长时程操作评估平台，通过原子重置技能库、在线空间场景图和 LLM 推理，在真实机器人上实现场景重置与评分，大幅减少人工干预并提升重置与评分准确率。
summary_zh: 机器人操控策略正在快速进步，而真实机器人评估仍然是衡量这一进步的标准证据。然而，这种评估仍然依赖人工在每次试验之间重置场景，这不仅消耗操作员的时间，还使得初始状态分布不明确，导致结果难以复现。最近的一个系统AutoEval实现了重置和评分的自动化，但仅适用于单步任务，因为长时程试验可能在组合爆炸的多种配置中终止，而单一学习到的重置策略无法覆盖所有这些情况。我们提出了HALTER——一种用于自主长时程任务评估与重置的框架，它通过在学习到的原子重置技能库上进行规划来恢复场景，因此示范成本与技能库的规模成正比，而非与终止状态的数量成正比。HALTER从点云和视觉基础模型中在线构建空间场景图，并由大语言模型在该图上进行推理，以对试验进行评分、规划重置以及验证重置是否成功，而无需为任何任务收集标注的成功图像。在Franka机械臂上的四项长时程任务中，HALTER在76%的试验中成功恢复了场景，而AutoEval为52%，基于运动规划的重置为65%；HALTER在90%的试验中正确估计了已完成技能的比例，而AutoEval为76%；其重置验证判定在91%的试验中正确，而AutoEval为78%。此外，与手动重置相比，HALTER将评估活动的操作员时间减少了72%。我们还在三项保留任务上测量了组合泛化能力，HALTER成功重置了74.7%的试验，而针对单一任务的重置策略仅为1.3%；同时，我们对场景表示和图更新频率进行了消融实验。

title: ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation. ViLoMan first transforms partial kinematic demonstrations of human-object interactions into complete, physically executable robot trajectories. It then leverages these trajectories within a teacher-student distillation framework to learn a unified policy that maps egocentric depth observations and proprioceptive measurements directly to joint-level whole-body actions. During deployment, the policy requires neither reference motions nor intermediate commands. We evaluate ViLoMan on door-closing tasks across diverse door configurations and robot initial conditions in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that a single policy enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to complete the full task using only onboard depth sensing and proprioception, while generalizing robustly across task variations and transferring effectively from simulation to reality. Project page: viloman-anonymous.pages.dev.
tldr: ViLoMan introduces a scalable framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that converts human demonstrations into robot trajectories and trains a teacher-student policy for unified whole-body control from egocentric depth and proprioception, enabling a Unitree G1 to close doors in simulation and the real world.
tldr_zh: ViLoMan提出了一种可扩展的人形机器人移动操作框架，将人类演示转换为机器人轨迹，并通过教师-学生蒸馏训练统一策略，使Unitree G1仅靠深度和本体感觉即可完成关门任务，且能泛化并迁移到真实世界。
summary_zh: 类人形机器人操作需要自适应的全身协调能力，以无缝整合运动控制与物理交互。尽管近年来取得了诸多进展，但由于缺乏多样化且物理上可执行的机器人-物体交互数据，以及难以直接从机载观测中学习统一的全身控制策略，学习自主类人操作仍然充满挑战。我们提出了ViLoMan，一个用于自主类人操作的可扩展框架。ViLoMan首先将人类-物体交互的部分运动学演示转换为完整且物理上可执行的机器人轨迹。随后，它利用这些轨迹，在教师-学生蒸馏框架中学习一个统一策略，该策略将自我中心的深度观测和本体感觉测量直接映射到关节级别的全身动作。在部署阶段，该策略既不需要参考运动，也不需要中间指令。我们在仿真和真实世界中，对多种门配置和机器人初始条件下的关门任务进行了ViLoMan评估。实验结果表明，仅依靠机载深度感知和本体感觉，单一策略即可使Unitree G1人形机器人完成整个任务，同时在不同任务变体中展现出稳健的泛化能力，并实现了从仿真到现实的有效迁移。项目页面：viloman-anonymous.pages.dev。

title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.
tldr: GAVEL introduces an explicit graph world model to verify and repair LLM-generated long-horizon robot plans, improving success rates on BEHAVIOR-1K by detecting violations and optimizing subtask ordering under partial observability.
tldr_zh: GAVEL 通过显式图世界模型验证和修复 LLM 生成的长时程机器人计划，在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上显著提升成功率，并在部分可观测下优化子任务顺序。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）为长时程机器人规划提供了灵活的接口，但生成的规划往往无法满足具身约束、无法从规划错误中恢复，或在部分可观测条件下难以进行有效推理。我们提出了GAVEL，一个围绕显式图世界模型构建的长时程LLM规划验证与修复框架。该图表示相关对象关系、动作前提与效果，以及对未观测对象位置的概率信念。该模型可以在执行前预测LLM生成动作的后果，检测违规行为，并修复那些可直接依据世界模型进行纠正的错误。该方法还将LLM重规划仅保留给需要语义推理的错误。对于多任务指令，GAVEL基于可能的对象位置分布进行推理，以重新排序剩余子任务并最小化期望搜索代价。我们在BEHAVIOR-1K上对GAVEL进行了评估，涵盖100个单一长时程任务和500个多任务指令。使用Qwen3-8B，GAVEL将单任务成功率从41.2%提升至91.8%，多任务成功率从19.9%提升至92.6%。与静态变体相比，分布性信念推理还将旅行距离减少了约5.4%。这些改进表明，显式图世界模型的约束机制能够显著提升长时程具身规划在紧凑型和前沿托管LLM能力下的可靠性与效率。

title: Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models
summary: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .
tldr: This paper introduces RoM-Nav, a hierarchical navigation framework for humanoid robots that decouples navigation and locomotion using a reduced-order model policy with full 3D LiDAR observations, plus a Poisson safety filter to handle out-of-distribution obstacles, demonstrating robust multi-floor mapless navigation on a Unitree G1.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 RoM-Nav，一种人形机器人分层导航框架，通过将导航与运动解耦，利用基于简化动力学模型但使用完整3D LiDAR观测的策略，并配合泊松安全过滤器处理分布外障碍，在 Unitree G1 上实现了鲁棒的多楼层无地图导航。
summary_zh: 仿人机器人研究在运动控制方面取得了快速进展，近期的成果也推动了自主导航领域的发展。我们证明，标准的单阶段强化学习导航流程在多楼层、多层地形中难以扩展，主要受限于复杂仿人地形交互（如楼梯）的挑战。为克服这一难题，我们将导航问题分解为两部分。首先，我们训练一个基于降阶动力学但利用完整3D激光雷达观测的策略，以导航复杂多层地形。随后，我们利用该导航知识启动一个基于全阶仿人动力学并集成固定运动控制策略的完整系统。此外，我们证明在导航策略输出上应用泊松安全滤波器，可以在面对分布外障碍时恢复安全性，且不牺牲导航成功率。我们在Unitree G1机器人上展示了所提出的RoM-Nav策略，成功完成了无地图多楼层导航，测试中垂直位移超过10米，路径长度超过100米。项目页面及视频地址：https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ 。

title: MM-Future: Multi-Mode Joint World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving involves coupled decision-making and scene evolution under multi-mode uncertainty. To capture this coupling and uncertainty, we introduce MM-Future, a world-action model that generates multiple paired scene-action hypotheses and models bidirectional interaction within each pair. Each hypothesis is initialized from a structured action prior and an independent future scene source, which are then co-evolved through a modality-aware diffusion Transformer. To support efficient multi-mode rollout, MM-Future compresses multi-view video into planning-oriented representations, dubbed MM-Tokens. Finally, a future-conditioned proposal scorer ranks trajectory candidates by shared history context and their paired predicted future. On NAVSIM navtest, MM-Future achieves 94.0 PDMS and 91.5 EPDMS, while attaining a 32.3 HD-Score in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show consistent improvements over both single-mode and action-only variants, validating the benefit of multi-mode joint world-action modeling.
tldr: MM-Future is a multi-mode world-action model for autonomous driving that jointly generates paired future scene and trajectory hypotheses via a diffusion Transformer, achieving state-of-the-art open-loop metrics and strong zero-shot closed-loop performance.
tldr_zh: MM-Future 是一种用于自动驾驶的多模态世界-动作联合模型，通过扩散 Transformer 联合生成配对的未来场景与轨迹假设，在开环指标上达到最优，并在零样本闭环评估中表现优异。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶涉及多模式不确定性下的耦合决策与场景演化。为捕捉这种耦合性与不确定性，我们提出MM-Future——一种世界-动作模型，能够生成多组配对的场景-动作假设，并建模每组内部的双向交互。每个假设均由结构化动作先验和独立未来场景源初始化，随后通过模态感知扩散Transformer共同演化。为支持高效的多模式展开，MM-Future将多视角视频压缩为面向规划的表征，称为MM-Tokens。最后，基于未来条件的提议评分器根据共享历史上下文及其配对的预测未来对轨迹候选进行排序。在NAVSIM navtest上，MM-Future达到94.0 PDMS和91.5 EPDMS，同时在HUGSIM的零样本闭环评估中获得32.3 HD-Score。消融实验显示，相较于单模式及仅动作变体均有持续改进，验证了多模式联合世界-动作建模的优势。

title: WZPlanner: Safe End-to-End Path Planning for Autonomous Driving in Work Zones
summary: Work zones alter lane geometry through temporary traffic controls and closures that may be absent from on-board maps, challenging autonomous vehicle (AV) perception and planning. Generalization is also limited by scarce public datasets with structured geometric supervision. We present WorkZonePlan, a dataset comprising 149K+ synthetic and 5K+ real-world multimodal samples with 3D annotations for lane boundaries, work zone boundaries, and driving trajectory options. It also provides 76 closed-loop CARLA scenarios replayed under three weather conditions, yielding 228 Bench2Drive-format evaluation routes. We introduce WAVE (Work-zone-focused AV data generation in Virtual and rEal Environments), a semi-automated pipeline for creating the dataset, and BoundaryFormer (BF), a transformer-based model that jointly predicts lane and work zone boundary polynomials and driving trajectories. BF uses slot attention for boundary prediction. Ablations show that a separate trajectory decoder using boundary slot features substantially improves trajectory prediction over a slot-attention-only approach. Building on this finding, BF++ offers Camera and Camera+LiDAR variants with metric ground-plane encoding, typed boundary/trajectory queries, long-range point anchors, image-space curve refinement, and conservative gated LiDAR fusion. On the 211 routes common to all four models at the evaluation freeze, BF++-Camera and BF++-Camera+LiDAR achieve Driving Scores of 63.0 and 64.4, respectively, compared with 59.3 for SimLingo and 26.1 for TransFuser++ (TF++). BF++ is 40 times smaller than SimLingo and more than 10 times smaller than TF++, while achieving higher Driving Scores. These results support jointly predicting lane boundaries, work zone boundaries, and driving trajectories as a promising direction toward safer AV operation in work zones. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Nishad-Sahu/WZPlanner.
tldr: This paper introduces the WorkZonePlan dataset and the WAVE pipeline for generating work-zone driving data, plus BoundaryFormer (BF++) models that jointly predict lane/work-zone boundaries and trajectories, achieving higher driving scores than larger baselines in CARLA.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WorkZonePlan数据集和WAVE半自动数据生成流程，以及联合预测车道/施工区边界和驾驶轨迹的BoundaryFormer模型，在CARLA中比更大规模的基线模型获得更高的驾驶分数。
summary_zh: 施工区通过临时交通管制和封闭措施改变车道几何形状，而这些信息可能未包含在车载地图中，对自动驾驶汽车（AV）的感知与规划构成挑战。此外，由于带有结构化几何监督的公开数据集稀缺，模型的泛化能力也受到限制。我们提出WorkZonePlan数据集，包含149K+合成样本和5K+真实世界多模态样本，带有车道边界、施工区边界及行驶轨迹选项的3D标注。该数据集还提供76个闭环CARLA场景，在三种天气条件下回放，生成228条Bench2Drive格式的评估路线。我们提出WAVE（面向施工区的虚拟与真实环境自动驾驶数据生成）半自动流水线用于构建该数据集，以及BoundaryFormer（BF）——一种基于Transformer的模型，联合预测车道与施工区边界多项式及行驶轨迹。BF采用槽注意力机制进行边界预测。消融实验表明，使用边界槽特征独立解码轨迹的模块，相比仅用槽注意力的方法显著提升了轨迹预测性能。基于此发现，BF++提供Camera和Camera+LiDAR两种变体，融合度量地面编码、类型化边界/轨迹查询、远距离点锚定、图像空间曲线细化以及保守门控LiDAR融合。在评估冻结时四种模型共有的211条路线上，BF++-Camera和BF++-Camera+LiDAR的驾驶分数分别为63.0和64.4，而SimLingo为59.3，TransFuser++（TF++）为26.1。BF++的模型规模比SimLingo小40倍，比TF++小10倍以上，同时取得更高的驾驶分数。这些结果支持将车道边界、施工区边界与行驶轨迹的联合预测作为提升自动驾驶汽车在施工区安全运行的有前景方向。代码与数据集：https://github.com/Nishad-Sahu/WZPlanner。

title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires models to draw on information from multiple modalities throughout the reasoning process. Yet existing methods often concatenate modality-specific thought tokens in a single sequence, leaving the model to bridge representational differences as it reasons across modalities. We introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that brings these thoughts into a shared latent space for reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into shared thought tokens, trained to preserve the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final answer or action. Because the same context can support multiple valid next steps, we use diffusion to predict the next block of thought tokens from the input and preceding blocks. Jointly training the encoder and diffusion reasoner with shared model weights encourages thought tokens to be both useful for the task and predictable from the available context. At inference, the model generates these tokens without teacher observations. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest evaluated baselines of 7.3% on visual reasoning tasks and 6.1% on robot manipulation tasks.
tldr: Uni-LaDiR unifies multimodal reasoning by projecting thought tokens from different modalities into a shared latent space and using diffusion to predict next thought blocks, achieving gains on VLM benchmarks and robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Uni-LaDiR 将不同模态的思考标记投影到共享潜在空间，并使用扩散模型预测后续思考块，从而在视觉语言模型基准和机器人操作任务上取得性能提升。
summary_zh: 多模态推理要求模型在整个推理过程中从多种模态中提取信息。然而，现有方法往往将特定模态的思维标记串联在单一序列中，使模型在跨模态推理时自行弥合表征差异。我们提出了Uni-LaDiR（统一潜在扩散推理器），一个将这些思维引入共享潜在空间进行推理的框架。统一编码器将来自不同模态的教师推理步骤映射为共享思维标记，并通过训练保留后续推理步骤及最终答案或行动所需的信息。由于相同的上下文可能支持多个有效的后续步骤，我们使用扩散模型从输入及前序块中预测下一块思维标记。通过共享模型权重联合训练编码器和扩散推理器，促使思维标记既对任务有用，又能从可用上下文中被预测。在推理阶段，模型无需教师观测即可生成这些标记。在十一个视觉语言模型（VLM）基准和两套视觉-语言-行动（VLA）任务中，Uni-LaDiR相较于评估中的最强基线，在视觉推理任务上取得了7.3%的相对提升，在机器人操作任务上取得了6.1%的相对提升。

title: StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation
summary: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.
tldr: StageGuard introduces an agentic distillation framework that trains a lightweight student VLM for accurate and efficient stage-transition prediction in long-horizon robot tasks, improving closed-loop task success in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: StageGuard 提出一种智能体蒸馏框架，训练轻量级学生 VLM 以准确高效地预测长时程机器人任务中的阶段转换，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了闭环任务成功率。
summary_zh: 分层规划框架结合多种机器人控制策略的技能，以完成长期任务执行，其中确定何时终止当前技能并推进至下一子任务至关重要。现有方法往往依赖预先设计的完成信号检查器，这些检查器在真实世界执行中难以获得。大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）具备强大的推理能力，但其决策边界与任务完成标准并非天然一致，同时云端部署和冗长的推理过程引入显著延迟，限制了实时监控能力。我们提出StageGuard，一种用于准确且高效阶段转换决策的代理蒸馏框架。StageGuard结合教师模型推理与示范轨迹，生成子任务完成和策略切换的结构化解释。轻量级学生VLM利用这些解释生成紧凑的自我解释，并用于监督微调。我们在两个基准测试的轨迹上评估阶段转换预测，并通过集成到BEHAVIOR-1K上的分层机器人控制来评估闭环任务成功率，同时在真实机器人上进行了进一步验证。结果表明，阶段转换预测性能显著提升，同时支持高效的在线监控。

title: Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control
summary: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.
tldr: This paper presents a stereo visual-servoing framework for AUVs, using target-specific depth estimation and adaptive model-fusion predictive control for real-time underwater target tracking, validated in simulations and real experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主水下航行器的立体视觉伺服框架，通过目标特定深度估计和自适应模型融合预测控制实现实时水下目标跟踪，并在仿真和实际实验中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 基于视觉的水下目标跟踪面临着深度测量不可靠和目标运动未知的挑战。本文提出了一种面向自主水下航行器（AUV）的立体视觉伺服框架。在感知方面，该框架通过目标特定深度提取和卡尔曼滤波，从立体图像中获取稳定的三维相对状态。它利用颜色、视差和时间线索构建目标深度掩码，以选取可靠的目标像素，然后分别对所得的深度测量值和检测到的图像中心进行滤波。在控制方面，该框架将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免了计算量大的耦合多自由度优化，并实现了实时平移模型预测控制（MPC）。平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，结合匀速和零速度目标模型，以适应不同的目标运动模式。它利用历史预测误差更新模型权重，并在执行机构、跟随距离和视场约束条件下计算平移控制指令。通过仿真和实际实验，我们验证了所提出框架的有效性，并表明其性能优于现有框架。

title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
summary: To operate effectively in human environments, robots must identify articulated objects, segment their movable and interactive parts, and estimate their kinematic models. Existing articulated scene representations typically recover kinematics from observed interactions, while methods operating on static scans often decouple articulation from functional interactive elements. We present FunArt, a framework that constructs articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs from posed RGB-D observations captured in a single static configuration. FunArt reconstructs object instances, converts their fused geometry directly into the O-Voxel representation of TRELLIS.2, and exploits its frozen, sparse-compression VAE as a structural prior. A lightweight query-based decoder combines compact object-level latents with dense, surface-aligned features to jointly segment movable parts and functional interactive elements while estimating motion type, axis, origin, and range. On the Articulate3D dataset, FunArt achieves state-of-the-art performance across movable-part segmentation, articulation estimation, and functional-element segmentation, both with and without ground-truth object input. In the end-to-end setting, it outperforms the strongest baselines by 1.5 AP_{50} points for movable parts, 2.8 AP_{50} points under joint origin-and-axis constraints, and 6.7 AP_{50} points for functional elements. These results demonstrate that generative 3D latents encode actionable structural cues that can initialize robotic perception and planning before physical interaction.
tldr: FunArt builds articulation-aware 3D scene graphs from a single static RGB-D observation by leveraging generative 3D latents (TRELLIS.2 VAE) to jointly segment movable parts and functional elements, and estimate kinematics, improving robotic pre-interaction perception.
tldr_zh: FunArt 利用生成式 3D 潜变量（TRELLIS.2 VAE），从单一静态 RGB-D 观测中构建关节感知的功能 3D 场景图，联合分割可动部件和功能元素并估计运动学，提升了机器人交互前的感知能力。
summary_zh: 为了使机器人在人类环境中有效运作，它们必须识别铰接物体，分割其可动部件和交互部件，并估计其运动学模型。现有的铰接场景表示通常从观测到的交互中恢复运动学信息，而基于静态扫描的方法往往将铰接结构与功能性交互元素相分离。我们提出了FunArt，一个从单一静态配置下采集的带姿态的RGB-D观测中构建具备铰接感知功能的三维场景图的框架。FunArt重建物体实例，将其融合几何直接转换为TRELLIS.2的O-Voxel表示，并利用其冻结的稀疏压缩VAE作为结构先验。一个轻量级的基于查询的解码器将紧凑的物体级潜变量与密集的、表面对齐的特征相结合，以联合分割可动部件和功能性交互元素，同时估计运动类型、轴、原点及范围。在Articulate3D数据集上，FunArt在可动部件分割、铰接估计和功能元素分割方面均达到了最先进的性能，无论是否提供真实物体输入。在端到端设置下，它在可动部件上超出最强基线1.5个AP_{50}百分点，在关节原点与轴约束下超出2.8个AP_{50}百分点，在功能元素上超出6.7个AP_{50}百分点。这些结果表明，生成式三维潜变量编码了可执行的结构线索，能够在物理交互之前初始化机器人感知与规划。

title: RTK-Vision PPO for Autonomous Micro UAV Recovery on an Airborne Carrier
summary: Autonomous recovery of a micro unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) onto a moving airborne carrier enables reusable deploy-mission-recover operation, but couples long-range rendezvous, close-range perception, carrier motion, aerodynamic interaction, and a discontinuous contact event. This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement-learning framework in which a child UAV is physically transported by a larger carrier, takes off from the carrier while airborne, executes an independent sortie, returns to the carrier's current position, redocks, and subsequently descends with the carrier. Both vehicles carry RTK-GNSS, and the carrier continuously shares its navigation state with the child. Near the recovery deck, RTK remains active while a downward-facing camera with a fiducial marker detector provides marker-relative alignment cues. A proximal policy optimization (PPO) policy governing the terminal recovery phase is trained in a physics-based MuJoCo simulation environment with explicit sensor noise models, an aerodynamic disturbance surrogate, and marker-latency randomization, then transferred to hardware. PX4 retains low-level stabilization, and a deterministic safety gate authorizes descent independently of the learned policy. The PPO checkpoint achieves 99.55% success over 2,000 held-out randomized terminal episodes, compared with 78.4% for a tuned PD baseline under identical conditions, with a median planar terminal error of 6.62 cm. Across 14 outdoor trials, the full mission succeeds in 13 trials (92.9%), spanning both near-region recovery and recovery after the carrier translates away from the release point. The results demonstrate a complete autonomous aerial deployment-and-recovery cycle rather than an isolated landing maneuver, establishing a practical basis for reusable carrier-child operation in inspection, surveillance, and mobile-logistics applications.
tldr: This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement learning framework for autonomous micro UAV recovery onto a moving airborne carrier, achieving high success in simulation and hardware trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于RTK视觉引导的强化学习框架，用于微型无人机在移动空中母舰上的自主回收，在仿真和硬件试验中均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh:
中文翻译：

微型无人机（UAV）在移动空中载机上自主回收，能够实现可重复的“部署-任务-回收”作业循环，但该过程同时涉及远距离交会、近距离感知、载机运动、气动干扰以及不连续的接触事件，极具挑战性。本文提出了一种基于RTK-视觉融合的强化学习框架，在该框架中，子无人机由大型载机物理携带，于空中从载机上起飞，执行独立任务，返回载机当前位置，完成对接，随后随载机一同下降。两架飞行器均搭载RTK-GNSS，载机持续向子机共享其导航状态。在回收甲板附近，RTK保持工作状态，同时下视相机配合基准标记检测器提供相对标记的对准信息。终端回收阶段由近端策略优化（PPO）策略控制，该策略在基于物理的MuJoCo仿真环境中训练，仿真中显式建模了传感器噪声、气动扰动代理以及标记延迟随机化，随后迁移至真实硬件。PX4负责底层稳定控制，确定性安全门独立于学习策略授权下降动作。在2,000个随机化的留出终端测试场景中，PPO检查点实现了99.55%的成功率，而在相同条件下，调优的PD基线策略成功率仅为78.4%，中位平面终端误差为6.62 cm。在14次室外试验中，完整任务在13次中成功完成（92.9%），覆盖近区回收以及载机平移离开释放点后的回收场景。研究结果表明，该系统实现了完整的自主空中部署与回收闭环，而非孤立的着陆操作，为巡检、监视及移动物流等应用中可重复使用的载机-子机作业奠定了实用基础。

title: Bayesian Continuum Robot Dynamics and State Estimation
summary: Recent factor graph approaches to continuum robot state estimation have been successful for quasi-static applications and spatiotemporal estimation using white-noise kinematic motion priors. However, when inertial effects are significant, these approximations may fail to capture the underlying physics, limiting accuracy during dynamic motions. In contrast, our approach approximates the Cosserat rod dynamics of continuum robots. We write inertia and damping as equivalent applied loads, so that the dynamic balance retains the algebraic form of the static one from prior work with quasi-static robots. Without backbone observations, the framework reduces to a stochastic forward simulation of the robot's motion. Given observations, it jointly refines kinematic and dynamic states and infers external loads, among other states. We validate the approach through simulation and experiments, demonstrating stochastic forward simulation as well as state estimation on tendon-driven continuum robots.
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian approach to continuum robot state estimation that incorporates Cosserat rod dynamics, improving accuracy during dynamic motions by modeling inertia and damping as equivalent applied loads, and validates it with tendon-driven continuum robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯的连续体机器人状态估计方法，通过将惯性和阻尼建模为等效施加载荷来纳入Cosserat杆动力学，在动态运动中提高了准确性，并在腱驱动连续体机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 近年来，基于因子图的连续体机器人状态估计方法在准静态应用以及利用白噪声运动学先验进行时空估计方面已取得成功。然而，当惯性效应显著时，这些近似方法可能无法捕捉底层物理特性，从而在动态运动过程中限制估计精度。相比之下，我们的方法对连续体机器人的Cosserat杆动力学进行近似。我们将惯性项和阻尼项表示为等效施加载荷，使得动态平衡保持与先前准静态机器人工作中静态平衡相同的代数形式。在没有骨干观测的情况下，该框架退化为机器人运动的随机前向仿真。在存在观测时，该框架联合优化运动学与动力学状态，并推断外部载荷等其他状态。我们通过仿真和实验验证了该方法，展示了肌腱驱动连续体机器人的随机前向仿真及状态估计能力。

title: CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding
summary: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58° after coarse initialization to 0.15° after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.
tldr: CoRef-GS introduces a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework that aligns multi-agent semantic maps and grounds view-conditioned referring expressions, improving multi-agent scene understanding for embodied robots.
tldr_zh: CoRef-GS 提出了一种协作式指代高斯泼溅框架，通过对齐多智能体语义地图并基于视点条件推理指代关系，提升了具身机器人的多智能体场景理解能力。
summary_zh: 具身机器人的指代场景理解要求从指定视角对以对象和关系为中心的语言查询进行接地。虽然局部语义高斯地图能够在一个智能体的观测范围内支持此类接地，但在协作场景中，这一能力需要在独立构建的地图经过对齐与融合后依然有效。在此设置下，被指代的目标或其上下文地标可能来自另一智能体的观测，而空间关系仍须从查询机器人的视角进行解读。我们将该问题形式化为融合地图上的协作式指代高斯接地，这要求几何可对齐性、实例级语义可比性以及视角条件下的关系推理。现有语言感知高斯方法主要聚焦于单地图查询，而高斯配准方法则优化几何或光度对齐，并未保留面向语言接地的语义兼容性。我们提出CoRef-GS，一种协作式指代高斯泼溅框架。CoRef-GS构建局部开放词汇的实例感知高斯地图，随后通过跨智能体对齐模块，依据几何与语义一致性将部分重叠的地图对齐，并利用视角条件下的掩码关系图对查询进行接地。我们进一步引入CoQuad-Ref，一个涵盖真实世界与仿真室内场景的双四足机器人基准。实验表明，在仿真场景中，CoRef-GS将旋转误差从粗初始化后的2.58°降至精化后的0.15°，并将真实场景下的指代mIoU从ReferSplat的52.6%提升至68.8%。所建立的基准与源代码将在https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git公开提供。

title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
summary: Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.
tldr: This paper introduces Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), a method that combines sampling-based model predictive control with first-order policy optimization to learn visual locomotion and manipulation policies directly from depth observations, demonstrated on simulated and real Unitree robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了采样引导策略搜索（SGPS），将基于采样的模型预测控制与一阶策略优化相结合，直接从深度观测学习视觉运动与操作策略，并在仿真和真实Unitree机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 学习用于移动和操作的视觉策略需要协调与环境的接触，并可能产生大量计算和GPU内存开销。一阶策略梯度（FoPG）通过可微仿真降低了训练成本，但局部优化可能收敛到非预期的接触模式。为解决这一不足，我们提出了采样引导策略搜索（SGPS），该方法将基于采样的模型预测控制所进行的循环动作目标优化与一阶策略优化相结合。行为克隆从采样动作中初始化策略；随后，训练过程在扰动初始状态和随机动力学条件下，交替进行基于采样的优化和短时域FoPG更新。对于视觉策略训练，我们采用了一种解耦的FoPG公式，该公式将渲染排除在计算图之外，从而能够直接从深度观测中学习，而无需状态策略教师。在单个GPU上，SGPS在模拟的Unitree Go2和G1机器人上学习移动、越障、推箱和双臂搬运策略。我们的实验进一步表明，优化不仅提升了策略学习的初始化和跟踪效果，还增强了整体性能。在硬件部署方面，蒸馏后的策略可零样本迁移至真实Go2机器人，并利用机载深度感知自主实现小跑、匍匐、跨栏以及这些行为之间的切换。

title: Walking on the Slope: Stable Bipedal Gaits with Genetic-Algorithm-Optimized Trajectories
summary: This paper presents the kinematic and dynamic modeling, trajectory generation, and stability analysis of an 8-degree-of-freedom (DOF) biped robot walking on flat and inclined terrain. Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) parameters and homogeneous transformations are used to derive the forward kinematics, while closed-form inverse kinematics maps the desired hip and swing-foot Cartesian trajectories, generated with cubic splines, to joint angles. Joint torques are computed using the Newton-Euler iterative algorithm, and dynamic stability is evaluated using the zero moment point (ZMP) criterion. A genetic algorithm (GA) optimizes the hip height, maximum swing-foot lift, and frontal-plane tilt angle by minimizing the work done by the joints subject to a ZMP feasibility penalty. Simulation results in MATLAB show that the nominal 8-DOF model remains ZMP-stable for step completion times down to 0.5 s and for slope inclinations up to 22.5 degrees with the given foot geometry. Beyond these limits, the ZMP leaves the support polygon, and either the foot dimensions or the trajectory parameters must be modified. The results also show that ZMP stability is governed by the mass distribution among the links rather than the total mass of the robot.
tldr: This paper presents kinematic and dynamic modeling, trajectory generation, and ZMP-based stability analysis for an 8-DOF biped robot walking on flat and inclined slopes, with a genetic algorithm optimizing trajectories for energy efficiency. Simulations show stable gaits up to 22.5° slope and 0.5s step time.
tldr_zh: 本文针对8自由度双足机器人，在平坦和斜坡上进行了运动学与动力学建模、轨迹生成和基于ZMP的稳定性分析，并采用遗传算法优化轨迹以降低能耗。仿真表明在22.5°坡度和0.5秒步长时间内可实现稳定行走。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了8自由度双足机器人在平坦与倾斜地形上行走的运动学与动力学建模、轨迹生成及稳定性分析。采用Denavit-Hartenberg参数与齐次变换推导正运动学，而闭式逆运动学则将期望的髋部及摆动脚笛卡尔轨迹（由三次样条生成）映射为关节角度。关节力矩通过牛顿-欧拉迭代算法计算，动态稳定性则依据零力矩点准则进行评估。遗传算法通过最小化关节做功并施加零力矩点可行性惩罚，对髋部高度、摆动脚最大抬起高度及额状面倾斜角进行优化。MATLAB仿真结果表明，在给定足部几何条件下，名义8自由度模型在步态完成时间短至0.5秒、坡度倾斜角高达22.5度时仍保持零力矩点稳定。超过这些极限后，零力矩点将离开支撑多边形，此时必须修改足部尺寸或轨迹参数。结果还表明，零力矩点稳定性主要由各连杆间的质量分布决定，而非机器人总质量。

title: OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline. The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io.
tldr: OmniMimic augments directional animal locomotion data into a single quadruped policy for omnidirectional commands via temporal reversal, dynamics completion, sagittal reflection, progressive command expansion, and a shared actor with gait-specialized experts, improving tracking and foot-position accuracy in simulation.
tldr_zh: OmniMimic 通过时间反转、动力学补全、矢状面反射、渐进式命令扩展以及共享actor与步态专家相结合，将方向受限的动物运动数据增强为支持全方位指令的四足策略，在仿真中提升了跟踪和足位精度。
summary_zh: 动物演示为四足机器人提供了自然且独特步态风格，而这些风格难以通过手工设计的奖励函数来明确指定。然而，这类演示在方向覆盖范围上较为狭窄，导致在后向、侧向及转向指令下缺乏风格一致的监督信号。我们提出了OmniMimic，一个训练框架，能够将方向受限的动物演示转化为覆盖目标各轴速度范围的单一多步态策略。OmniMimic首先结合时间反转、约束动力学补全及矢状面反射，在观测方向之外构建机器人特定的运动学与物理监督信号。随后，它逐步将命令从演示的速度分布扩展至目标各轴边界，并采用共享演员网络配合软门控、步态特化的残差专家模块，以平衡可复用 locomotion 技能与步态特定修正。在仿真中针对四种步态，与匹配的APEX基线相比，OmniMimic在前向及后向参考速度下将平均脚部位置RMSE降低了12.9%，在均匀笛卡尔命令网格上的速度跟踪RMSE降低了63.1%。项目页面网址为 https://OmniMimic.github.io。

title: Spatial-Semantic Uncertainty in VLM-Based Target Search: Balancing Exploration and Identification
summary: Robots searching for a target from a natural-language description must determine not only where to search, but also which observed candidate is the desired target. These decisions reflect two distinct sources of uncertainty - spatial uncertainty over candidate locations and semantic uncertainty over target identity - that are often conflated in VLM-based search systems. We introduce a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation that maintains separate beliefs over each component and integrates probabilistic VLM evidence into a global target-identity posterior, including probability mass for undiscovered targets. This decomposition allows an information-theoretic planner to independently value candidate discovery and target disambiguation through spatial and semantic expected information gain (EIG), providing an explicit mechanism for trading broader exploration against earlier identification. We evaluate six VLM uncertainty-elicitation interfaces on 500 synthetic targets and show that similar recognition accuracy can conceal substantial differences in calibration and false confidence. In degraded-observation search-and-identify experiments, EIG-based planners reach confident decisions in 75.0%-92.5% of trials, compared with 20.0% for Random search, while different spatial-semantic weightings achieve comparable identification accuracy once confidence is attained. Increasing semantic emphasis reduces unnecessary exploration and VLM queries, demonstrating that explicitly planning over semantic uncertainty can accelerate target resolution without sacrificing decision quality. These results highlight the distinct roles of uncertainty representation and uncertainty-driven planning in embodied VLM systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation for VLM-based target search, enabling information-theoretic planners to balance exploration and identification, and demonstrates that explicit semantic uncertainty planning accelerates target resolution without sacrificing decision quality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于VLM目标搜索的空间-语义不确定性公式，使信息论规划器能够平衡探索与识别，并证明显式的语义不确定性规划可加速目标解决而不牺牲决策质量。
summary_zh: 机器人在根据自然语言描述搜索目标时，不仅需要确定搜索的位置，还必须判断所观察到的候选对象是否为期望目标。这些决策反映了两种不同来源的不确定性——候选位置的空间不确定性和目标身份语义的不确定性——而在基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的搜索系统中，这两种不确定性常常被混为一谈。我们提出了一种空间-语义不确定性建模方法，分别对两个分量维护独立的置信度，并将概率性的VLM证据整合到全局目标身份后验中，同时为未发现目标保留概率质量。该分解使得基于信息论的规划器能够通过空间和语义期望信息增益（EIG）独立评估候选发现与目标消歧的价值，从而提供一种在更广泛探索与更早识别之间进行权衡的显式机制。我们在500个合成目标上评估了六种VLM不确定性 elicitation 接口，结果表明相似的识别准确率可能掩盖校准性和虚假置信度方面的显著差异。在退化观测条件下的搜索与识别实验中，基于EIG的规划器在75.0%至92.5%的试验中达到确信决策，而随机搜索仅为20.0%；同时，一旦达到置信状态，不同的空间-语义权重分配可获得相当的识别准确率。增加语义权重可减少不必要的探索和VLM查询，这表明显式地规划语义不确定性可以在不牺牲决策质量的前提下加速目标确认。这些结果凸显了不确定性表示与不确定性驱动规划在具身VLM系统中的不同作用。

title: Time-Efficient Iterative Learning Planning for Safety-Critical Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
summary: Autonomous mobile robots require timeefficient planning and safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance under constrained onboard computation. While Iterative Learning Planning (ILP) offers lightweight and efficient traversal planning, it lacks explicit mechanisms for dynamic obstacle perception and avoidance. This article extends ILP to safety-critical navigation in dynamic environments by integrating an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function (ARB-CBF). The extended ILP learns traversal-speed and steering-bias profiles via a fractionalpower update based on local obstacle risk, generating nominal control commands that ARB-CBF modifies at runtime for real-time safety guarantees. Algorithmic analysis demonstrates that the ILP replanning stage scales at O(kN) for k iterations and N waypoints, while ARB-CBF executes with linear complexity. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the framework, demonstrating superior temporal efficiency and safety with lower computational overhead compared to optimizationbased baselines, making it highly suitable for resourceconstrained platforms.
tldr: This paper extends Iterative Learning Planning with an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function for time-efficient, safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance on resource-constrained mobile robots, validated in simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文通过引入预期风险混合控制屏障函数扩展迭代学习规划，实现资源受限移动机器人在动态环境中的高时效安全避障，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。
summary_zh: 自主移动机器人在机载计算资源受限的条件下，需要实现时间高效的规划与安全关键的动态避障。尽管迭代学习规划（ILP）提供了轻量级且高效的遍历规划方法，但其缺乏针对动态障碍物感知与避让的显式机制。本文将ILP扩展至动态环境中的安全关键导航任务，通过引入一种预测性风险混合控制屏障函数（ARB-CBF）加以实现。扩展后的ILP基于局部障碍风险，采用分数阶幂更新机制学习遍历速度与转向偏置剖面，生成名义控制指令，并由ARB-CBF在运行时进行修正，以提供实时安全保障。算法分析表明，ILP重规划阶段在k次迭代和N个航路点条件下的复杂度为O(kN)，而ARB-CBF以线性复杂度执行。综合仿真与真实世界实验验证了该框架的有效性，结果表明，相较于基于优化的基线方法，该方法在时间效率与安全性方面表现更优，且计算开销更低，非常适合资源受限平台使用。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.
tldr: Navi-Agent introduces a zero-shot VLN-CE agent using a coordinate-free spatial state built from visual observations and motion histories, achieving state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods and competitive results with geometric localization approaches.
tldr_zh: Navi-Agent 提出了一种零样本 VLN-CE 智能体，利用视觉观察和运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，在几何约束方法中达到最优性能，并与依赖几何定位的方法竞争表现。
summary_zh: 连续环境中的视觉-语言导航要求具身智能体在未知环境中执行长时段指令。现有的零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航系统通常通过几何定位或基于坐标的表征来维护空间状态。近期的几何约束导航方法去除了深度信息和全局一致坐标，但在维护持久空间感知以进行地点确认、进度验证和恢复方面仍面临挑战。我们提出Navi-Agent，一种零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航智能体，它从视觉观察和已执行的运动历史中构建无坐标空间状态。Navi-Agent将该状态组织为导航拓扑结构，其中节点表示视觉地点，边表示运动转换。这种表征支持基于观察的近似自定位、任务进度验证以及基于视觉重访的恢复机制。Navi-Agent通过将指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航，并利用所构建的空间状态验证已访问地点来实现闭环导航。在零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航基准和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时与依赖几何定位的方法相比仍具有竞争力。

title: EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute
summary: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.
tldr: EliGSiR introduces a continual RGB-D mapper using 3D Gaussian Splatting with adaptive view scheduling, load-adaptive fidelity, and targeted geometry growth, achieving higher reconstruction quality and lower compute than existing methods on RGB-D SLAM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EliGSiR 提出了一种基于 3D 高斯散射的持续 RGB-D 建图方法，通过自适应视图调度、负载自适应保真度和定向几何增长，在 RGB-D SLAM 基准上以更低计算量实现了更高的重建质量。
summary_zh: 常规三维高斯泼溅假设观测集封闭且优化时间表较长。相比之下，持续RGB-D建图面临的问题是：新的观测在线到达，而先前重建的区域必须被保留。我们提出EliGSiR（基于证据引导与图像回放的负载自适应增量式高斯泼溅），这是一种持续式高斯建图器，能够随着重建的进展控制可用优化预算的使用方式。地图引导的视图调度根据地图当前状态过滤冗余的输入视图，并重新考虑已保留的视图。负载自适应保真度根据当前建图负载调整监督分辨率，而非遵循固定的分辨率计划。定向几何增长将深度监督与高斯生成分离，仅在重复RGB-D观测表明存在缺失或错位结构的位置增加几何容量。这些机制共同调整了哪些视图被优化、使用了多少图像细节，以及在建图持续进行期间表示在何处增长。我们在Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++以及真实RGB-D传感器序列上评估了EliGSiR，同时考虑了最终重建结果和采集过程中可用的地图。在TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household序列上，在受控基线使用相同真值建图位姿的条件下，EliGSiR达到21.52 dB，而SplaTAM为19.42 dB。在跟踪位姿对比中，使用实时ORB-SLAM3位姿的EliGSiR在155.5秒内达到23.02 dB，而使用原生跟踪器的CaRtGS在230.9秒内为20.10 dB。我们进一步评估了采集过程中的重建质量，并展示了EliGSiR的自适应视图调度、监督保真度和几何增长如何改善可用建图预算的使用。

title: GPT-6-Astra in a Navigation Workflow: Behavioral Analysis in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: We study GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) system, where it interprets instructions, assesses its surroundings, and proposes actions. The system uses a common observation--decision--execution workflow with direct model API calls, without a packaged agent harness or navigation-specific fine-tuning. In this workflow, each request receives selected observations, execution feedback, and retained progress records. Evaluation covers the complete system, including context management and action control. We evaluate the system on 50 of the 100 R2R-CE val-unseen episodes used by Open-Nav. It achieves a success rate of 52.0\%, an SPL of 48.9\%, and an nDTW of 70.8\%. Our analysis highlights three findings. First, recorded responses link landmarks and earlier actions to instructions using observations and supplied history. Second, reviews include requests for additional views and revisions of uncertain judgments. Third, the results suggest a gap between task understanding and autonomous completion: an unfinished crossing is recognized while rotation continues. At termination, 36.0\% of episodes succeed with a workflow-accepted STOP, while another 16.0\% meet the distance criterion at the step limit. These results highlight a central challenge: translating correct local judgments into sustained progress and appropriate stopping.
tldr: This paper evaluates GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot VLN-CE system across 50 R2R-CE episodes, reporting a 52.0% success rate and analyzing its decision-making, highlighting gaps between local understanding and autonomous navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文在连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）系统中评估了GPT-6-Astra的零样本表现，在R2R-CE的50个片段中实现了52.0%的成功率，并分析了其决策过程，揭示了局部理解与自主导航之间的差距。
summary_zh: 我们在零样本连续环境视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）系统中研究了GPT-6-Astra，该系统负责解析指令、评估周围环境并提议动作。该系统采用常见的观察—决策—执行工作流程，通过模型API直接调用，未使用封装的代理框架或导航专用微调。在此工作流程中，每次请求都会收到选定的观察信息、执行反馈以及保留的进度记录。评估涵盖整个系统，包括上下文管理和动作控制。我们在Open-Nav所用的100个R2R-CE未见验证集情节中选取了50个进行系统评估。该系统实现了52.0%的成功率、48.9%的SPL和70.8%的nDTW。我们的分析突出了三个发现。首先，记录的回答将地标和早期动作通过观察及提供的历史信息与指令关联起来。其次，审查过程中包括对额外视角的请求以及对不确定判断的修正。第三，结果揭示了任务理解与自主完成之间的差距：在旋转继续时，系统识别出未完成的穿越。在终止时，36.0%的情节以工作流接受的停止指令成功完成，另有16.0%的情节在步数限制内达到距离标准。这些结果凸显了一个核心挑战：将正确的局部判断转化为持续进展和适当的停止行为。

title: Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation
summary: Collecting real-world navigation data for mobile robots typically requires platform-specific teleoperation, making large-scale collection expensive and difficult to scale. We introduce Universal Navigation Interface (UNI), a robot-free data collection paradigm that uses a four-wheeled rollator walker (rollator) and smartphone to collect physically constrained human demonstrations. Because the rollator cannot climb stairs, negotiate uncut curbs, or pass through narrow gaps, demonstrations are naturally biased toward wheeled-feasible routes. Using UNI, we collect 37.2 km of real-world navigation data and recover metric trajectories that directly supervise goal-conditioned navigation models. Fine-tuning visual-navigation models on UNI reduces trajectory prediction error by 17.4-24.8% on held-out UNI demonstrations. Evaluation on other navigation datasets shows benefits that vary by dataset and metric. We further demonstrate closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair in curb, staircase, and curb-cut scenarios. These results support low-cost physical proxies as a practical source of navigation supervision collected without the target robot.
tldr: UNI introduces a robot-free data collection paradigm using a rollator walker and smartphone to gather physically constrained human demonstrations for training wheeled robot navigation policies, demonstrating reduced trajectory prediction error and closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair.
tldr_zh: UNI提出了一种使用助行器和智能手机的免机器人数据收集范式，通过物理约束的人类演示训练轮式机器人导航策略，在轨迹预测误差和闭环节轮式转移方面取得了良好效果。
summary_zh: 收集移动机器人的真实世界导航数据通常需要特定平台上的远程操作，这使得大规模数据采集成本高昂且难以扩展。我们引入了通用导航接口（UNI），一种无需机器人的数据采集范式，利用四轮助行器（rollator）和智能手机来采集受物理约束的人类示范。由于助行器无法攀爬楼梯、通过未切边的路缘石或穿过狭窄间隙，示范数据自然偏向于轮式可行路径。利用UNI，我们采集了37.2公里的真实世界导航数据，并恢复了可用于直接监督目标条件导航模型的度量轨迹。在UNI示范数据上微调视觉导航模型，可将留出集上的轨迹预测误差降低17.4%至24.8%。在其他导航数据集上的评估显示，收益因数据集和指标而异。我们进一步展示了在路缘石、楼梯和路缘切割场景中向电动轮椅的闭环迁移。这些结果支持低成本物理代理作为无需目标机器人即可采集的实用导航监督来源。

title: Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot
summary: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.
tldr: This paper presents a quadruped robot (Boston Dynamics Spot) equipped with a milling tool for mechanical weed removal, along with a software architecture for autonomous operation, and analyzes its accuracy and efficiency in indoor and outdoor settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种配备铣削工具的四足机器人（波士顿动力Spot）用于机械除草，并开发了自主操作的软件架构，在室内和室外环境中分析了其精度和效率。
summary_zh: 基于除草剂的杂草防控因杂草抗性不断增强及化学药剂使用对环境造成的不利影响而日益难以为继。尽管机械除草避免了这些弊端，但其通常采用大型机械实施，容易导致土壤板结。我们提出了一种基于小型移动机器人进行机械除草的新方案。与现有的自动化机械除草方法相比，该方法具有减少土壤压实、自动化更简单以及可扩展性更优等优势。该方案采用一台波士顿动力公司生产的Spot四足机器人，其末端配备定制除草工具，工具端部装有铣削钻头。该工具刚性连接于机器人本体，通过驱动腿部执行器利用机器人基座的自由度，同时保持足端固定不动。我们开发了一套支持自主除草的软件架构，并将该系统与所有其他必要组件集成。我们在室内和室外环境中分别对当前概念验证系统的精度和效率进行了分析，并为后续提升系统精度与效率提供了改进建议。

title: Execution-Aware Pre-Execution Ranking for Grasp-Conditioned Robotic Placement
summary: A geometrically valid placement can still be difficult to execute because the selected grasp changes the required end-effector pose, collision geometry, and transport motion. Placement is formulated as a pre-execution ranking problem in which supplied grasp-placement candidates are scored before planning. The model combines a typed target-conditioned point cloud with three pose descriptors and hierarchical heads for planning success and execution success conditioned on planning. On a 30-object, 1,235-scene dataset with scene-group-held-out splits, three-seed top-1 success on covered test groups reaches 85.63 +/- 1.08% for joint selection and 79.84 +/- 0.16% for fixed-target ranking. For the designated frozen seed-42 checkpoint, top-1 success improves from 72.84% to 85.78% over full-pool cuMotion for joint ranking and from 59.65% to 79.67% for fixed-target ranking. Frozen transfer to xArm7/MoveIt requires no xArm-specific retraining. Across 27 locked cases, 13 complete end to end (48.15%). Of the 16 cases that pass Top-5 preflight and begin execution, 13 succeed (81.25%). Candidate-level deployment-feasibility prediction reaches 81.25% recall, 85.20% specificity, and 83.23% balanced accuracy.
tldr: This paper introduces a pre-execution ranking framework for grasp-conditioned robotic placement, using a typed target-conditioned point cloud and hierarchical heads to jointly select grasp and placement candidates before motion planning. It demonstrates improved top-1 success rates over a baseline on a 30-object dataset and successful frozen transfer to a different robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于抓取条件机器人放置的预执行排序框架，利用类型化目标条件点云和分层头在运动规划前联合选择抓取和放置候选。在30个物体的数据集上，相较于基线，top-1成功率有所提升，并成功冻结迁移至不同的机械臂。
